analyticalQuestion: Can signed heat-scale production observables alone control a positive amplitude-cubic exterior-size quantity on the exact shear family?
supportedClaim: For every real amplitude in the frozen exact-shear family, the signed heat-scale production observables vanish pointwise at every positive heat scale. For every nonzero amplitude, the heat-gradient covariance is strictly positive; at zero amplitude it is zero. The normalized positive exterior-size quantity is amplitude-cubic. Therefore a finite amplitude-independent coercive modulus built only from zero-preserving operations on those production observables cannot control the nonzero, unbounded-amplitude subfamily.
supportedTakeaway: The exact family has zero signed production at every heat scale; every nonzero member has strictly positive heat-gradient covariance and amplitude-cubic positive size, while the zero-amplitude member is trivial.
